clock_model.authoring_policy: Majora-style predictable daily cycle with editable schedule blocks.

day_phases.summary: Citizens wake up, leave homes, and begin district movement.
Jobs, schools, guard posts, clinics, markets, and service work become active.
Meal breaks and public plaza overlaps create visible social clusters.
Work resumes and couriers/service routes continue.
Personal activities, friend visits, plaza activity, and hobbies become visible.
Most citizens return home while guards, restricted workers, and emergency crews can stay active later.
